operator.name: phi_fb_adaptive
operator.scene_n_source: external sequential loop counter; NOT stored in MuState; declared input to operator

dual_arithmetic.note: gamma_eff(n) is a primary-space operator parameter, NOT a dual-space accumulator
dual_arithmetic.scene_n: primary space counter; not a ghost residual; not stored in dual channels
dual_arithmetic.separation_preserved: S_A/S_D remain in dual space; gamma_eff is primary scalar

fork_A: phi_fb_adaptive(scene_n=0) == beta_Z_base (no feedback at cold start)
phi_fb_adaptive(scene_n=1, B_A>0) < phi_fb_exp(B_A>0) (gamma ramp < full gamma)
leaf_count* stable after n=3 (regression across all steps)
gradient monotone: phi_fb_adaptive increasing B_A, decreasing B_D
fork_B: bze_fwd(n) == bze_mir(n) for all n (phi_fb_adaptive P_yz-invariant)
